subject: Query regarding BTL statement fee - account BTL-49201948
body:
Hello,

My accountant is currently going through my self-assessment figures for the last tax year and raised a query regarding my buy-to-let mortgage account (ref BTL-49201948, property at 42 High Street). 

On the November statement, there is a £120 'Arrears Admin Fee' charged to the balance. However, looking back at my business bank statements, the monthly direct debit went through on the 1st of November as usual without issue. 

My accountant has asked if I can get this clarified so we can finalize the property accounts. Could someone please review the payment application for that month and confirm if this fee was added in error? If so, please arrange for it to be credited back.

No huge rush on this, just whenever someone has a chance to look into it.

Best regards,
Marcus Vance

subject: Discrepancy on Personal Loan Statement - Ref: PL-884029-X
body: Dear Customer Services Team, I am writing to politely bring to your attention a discrepancy I have observed on my latest personal loan statement dated 12th October for account number PL-884029-X. Although my monthly installment of £214.50 was dispatched via standing order well before the fifth of the month as customary, I notice a £25 late payment fee has been levied alongside an additional interest charge, which appears to stem from a delay on your system in clearing the funds. As I am living on a fixed retirement income and monitor my outgoings meticulously, I would be most grateful if you could look into this matter as a priority and reverse the incorrect charges prior to my next monthly balance check next week. Yours sincerely, Arthur Pendelton.

subject: Urgent: Incorrect £150 fee on secured loan account HLS-440291
body: Hello, I am writing regarding my homeowner loan (ref: HLS-440291). I have already spoken to your customer support team twice this month about the £150 administration fee added to my account on 4th November, which I was explicitly promised on the phone would be waived following your previous processing error. My direct debit is due to be taken in five days' time, and I really cannot afford to have this incorrect amount drawn from my bank account again. Please can someone confirm in writing today that this fee has finally been removed and that only the agreed monthly payment of £482.10 will be debited? Best regards, Sarah Jenkins.

subject: Incorrect ERC on Redemption Statement - BTL Ref BTL-77209-M
body: Re: Buy-to-Let Mortgage BTL-77209-M (14 Oakfield Road). I received the redemption statement yesterday for the upcoming product switch scheduled for 30th November, and I note an Early Repayment Charge of £1,850 has been applied. As per the original offer terms, the new fixed-rate deal takes effect on the exact day the current term expires, so no ERC is triggered. Given that completion with my conveyancer is set for next Friday, I require an amended redemption statement issued by return showing the ERC removed so we do not delay drawdown. Regards, Marcus Vance.

subject: Unauthorised arrears fee on BTL account - Second Follow Up (Ref: REF-882910-BTL)
body: I am writing again regarding the £150 late payment fee applied to my buy-to-let account (mortgage ref 40029188) on 2nd December. As per my previous email sent on 14th November (ref REF-882910-BTL), my payment was made on time via Faster Payments. You acknowledged an internal system delay on your end, yet you have now charged me interest on this incorrect fee as well! I am due to complete a remortgage next week and this bogus charge is showing as an outstanding balance, which is threatening my completion. Remove this charge and refund the £12.40 interest immediately today, or I will elevate this to the Financial Ombudsman.

subject: Incorrect interest rate applied to BTL portfolio - urgent correction required
body: Hello, my accountant (David Higgins at TaxWise) was reviewing my year-end accounts yesterday for my buy-to-let property on Birch Road and noticed that you have allocated my £1,850 monthly payments entirely towards interest, completely ignoring the overpayment capital reduction agreed in August. My accountant has calculated that you have overcharged me by £412.30 in interest over the last four months alone. As a self-employed landlord, I cannot have my cash flow disrupted like this, especially with my tax return deadline looming. I need a manager to look into this account today and issue a corrected statement showing the payment split accurately before my Direct Debit goes out on Friday.

subject: Disputed £350 product transfer fee - Joint Mortgage Account 88301923
body: Dear Customer Services, I am writing on behalf of myself and my husband, Mark Taylor, regarding our joint mortgage. Our 2-year fixed rate expires at the end of this month. We selected a new deal online last week, but you have debited an upfront £350 product fee from our bank account today despite us explicitly ticking the box to add it to the loan balance! This has plunged our joint current account into an unarranged overdraft, incurring bank charges right now. We need this £350 refunded back to our bank account immediately today. Please call us urgently on 07700 900482 to confirm this has been processed.

subject: Dispute wrong fee on mortgage account M-44019282
body:
Hello. Please help me quick. My fixed deal finish on 30 November. I get letter saying you charge me £850 Early Repayment Charge because I make payment last month. But your person on phone tell me last month I can pay £1,000 extra without fee! Now my account is bad, and new mortgage company say I cannot switch deal because of this fee debt.

I am sick with heart problem and disabled, I have no money for this £850. If I stay on variable rate next month I cannot pay mortgage and my children have no food. This is very wrong, your phone person give bad advice. Fix this fee now or I go to Financial Ombudsman Service and make big official complaint. My reference is M-44019282. Mrs Elena Popescu.

subject: Fixed rate renewal - self employed criteria
body:
Hello,

Our fixed rate deal on mortgage ref 40982210/2 is coming to an end in November. I'm self-employed (Sole Trader) and my accountant is currently working on my 2023/24 tax return. 

Could you send over information on your current product transfer rates for existing customers? Also, could you clarify what documentation you usually require for self-employed renewals—do I need to submit full SA302s again if I am staying with you for a simple rate switch? No rush on this, just getting organized ahead of time.

Best regards,
Mark Jenkins

subject: Quick query on loan early settlement / top up
body:
Hi, currently have a personal loan with you guys (ref PL-88391). Looking to find out what your standard policy is for making a lump sum overpayment vs settling early? Are there early repayment charges on fixed rate personal loans? Also interested in standard rates if I wanted to top up by another £3k. Send link to info page if easier. Ta, Sarah

Sent from my iPhone

subject: Inquiry regarding Second Charge / Secured Homeowner Loan Terms
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I currently hold a buy-to-let mortgage with your organization under account reference BTL-004921. 

I am writing to request details regarding your published criteria and maximum Loan-to-Value ratios for secured homeowner loans (second charges) on primary residences. I am evaluating options to raise capital for minor works across my residential portfolio and would appreciate a breakdown of your current standard variable and fixed interest tiers for second charges, alongside any standard arrangement fees.

Yours faithfully,
David Palmer
Palmer Property Holdings

subject: Unsecured Personal Loan - Policy Clarification Request
body:
Good morning,

I am considering applying for an unsecured personal loan of £12,000 in the coming months. Before making a formal application, I would be grateful if you could confirm your general policy on the following four points:

1. What is the maximum permitted loan duration for borrowing amounts between £10,000 and £15,000?
2. Are your published APR tiers fixed for the duration of the agreement, or subject to variation?
3. What is your standard allowance for penalty-free overpayments per calendar year?
4. What is the typical timeframe from online approval to fund disbursement?

Thank you for your assistance with these routine details.

Yours sincerely,
Graham Thompkins

subject: Query regarding early repayment charges - Loan Ref PL-992018
body:
Hello, I've tried calling your customer service team twice today regarding my personal loan (ref PL-992018), but the line dropped the first time and the second person I spoke to wasn't entirely sure about the early settlement rules and suggested I send an email instead.

Could you please clarify what the standard policy is if I want to make an overpayment of £1,500 on my loan? Specifically, I'd like to know if there's an early repayment fee or penalty for paying off a chunk early, or if it just reduces the remaining term automatically. 

No rush on this as I'm planning to do it next month once my work bonus comes through.

Thanks,
Sandra Higgins

subject: Enquiry regarding early repayment terms and overpayment policy - Ref: SHL/884920
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to politely request clarification regarding the precise early repayment charges and current overpayment allowance applicable to our existing secured homeowner loan, as my wife and I are currently attempting to finalise our financial arrangements for some necessary roof repairs. While I have endeavoured to navigate your online documentation to ascertain these details myself, I regret to state that I found the terms regarding whether the penalty fee applies to the entire balance or merely the surplus above the ten percent annual threshold rather unclear. Given that our contractor requires confirmation of available funds by Friday afternoon, I would be exceedingly grateful if you could provide a concise summary of your published overpayment rules and early settlement terms at your earliest convenience.

Yours faithfully,

Alistair Fairfax

subject: Personal loan repayment schedule and lump sum policy - PL77391B
body:
Hello,

I have now called your helpline twice this week to get a simple answer about the exact process for making an additional lump-sum payment on my personal loan (PL77391B), but I keep being bounced around without getting a clear answer. 

Could someone please just send me the written policy detailing how to submit a partial early settlement, whether there is a minimum payment threshold, and how quickly my monthly direct debit will be adjusted afterwards? I am trying to sort my finances before a house move next Friday and I really need this information today so I can make the payment.

Thanks,
Gemma Hollis

subject: URGENT: BTL ERC Policy Confirmation Needed Today - Ref BTL/904218
body: Following up on email ref BTL/904218 dated 12th October. I've phoned twice already this week. I urgently need your published policy criteria regarding Early Repayment Charges when switching BTL products mid-term. My solicitor is waiting on this to finalize the redemption statement before 4pm today otherwise my buyer's funds will be returned and the whole chain falls through, costing me thousands in legal fees. Can someone please confirm the exact percentage tiered structure for Year 3 ERCs under your standard BTL terms? I know this should be standard policy info but I need it in writing immediately.

subject: URGENT help fixed rate end / Account 40029112
body: Hello. My fixed rate deal finish on 30 November. Mortgage number 40029112. I am very scared because my husband lost job last month and if price go to standard variable rate we cannot pay and bank take our house. I need to know what are your new fixed rates today and how I can change to new deal now before end of month. I look on website but I don't understand the fee and process to change. Please send me list of product transfer rates and how to apply fast. If payments go up £400 I cannot buy food for my children. Please answer quick.

subject: Annual statement request - Loan HL-884920-A
body: Good morning team. My accountant is currently working through my end-of-year figures and has asked for a full breakdown of the interest paid on my homeowner loan (ref HL-884920-A) for the 2023/24 tax year. Could you please send over an official copy of the annual statement at your convenience? There is no immediate rush as the submission isn't due for a few weeks yet, but whenever you get a moment to email or post it through that would be much appreciated. Many thanks, Julian Vance.

subject: BTL Mort BTL-0094183 - change Direct Debit date
body: Hi, need to switch DD payment date on mortgage BTL-0094183 from 1st of month to 10th. Fits better with tenant rent collection dates. Please confirm once updated or let me know if a form is needed. Sent from my iPhone.

subject: Urgent request for duplicate annual statement - Account Ref HL/40291-B
body: Dear Customer Service Team, I am writing to formally request a full duplicate copy of my latest annual account statement for my secured homeowner loan, as I am currently preparing my financial documents for my tax advisor and notice that the original statement appears to have been misplaced during our recent moving of study furniture. As my accountant requires these figures by the end of next week, I would be extremely grateful if you could arrange to dispatch a copy to my registered address or send a secure document via email as a matter of some priority.

subject: Direct debit date alteration ahead of fixed rate expiry - Ref 8839012/01
body: Good morning. I am writing again regarding my fixed-rate mortgage which is due to expire at the end of next month. I have tried adjusting this through the online portal without success, but I urgently need my monthly direct debit payment date shifted from the 1st to the 28th of the month to align with my pay date before the new interest rate takes effect. Given that the rate switch deadline is approaching and my previous online inquiry went unanswered, I would appreciate confirmation today that this payment date update has been implemented.

subject: Change of Correspondence Address - BTL Ref BTL-994012
body: Please update the correspondence address for my buy-to-let mortgage on 14 Westgate Terrace (Ref BTL-994012) with immediate effect. All future postal notices and statements must be sent to my business premises at 42 High Street, Suite 3, Chester, CH1 2BN, rather than the rental property address. I require this administrative change updated in your database before the end of the week to prevent any misdirection of upcoming annual documentation. Kindly confirm once the record has been updated.

subject: THIRD ATTEMPT: Final redemption figure needed - BTL-304918
body: I am writing this email because I have already telephoned your customer service center twice today, at 9:15am and 2:10pm, and was cut off both times while waiting on hold for the redemption desk. I need a final payoff quote for my buy-to-let account BTL-304918 calculated to 30th November, as my solicitor requires it urgently to complete the sale of the property this week. Please issue this redemption statement and send it to me by return email without further delay.

subject: URGENT: Settlement quote needed - Ref PL-883920-B
body: I am chasing up my request from 14th November (ref: REF-99201-PL). I still haven't received the early payoff quote for my personal loan. I have called twice already this week and was promised it would be emailed within 24 hours. I need the exact settlement figure by 4pm today as my lender is finalizing my debt consolidation and if I don't have the final payout figure, the new offer expires and I will lose my arrangement fee of £250. Please email the quote to me urgently.

subject: BTL Mortgage Statement needed TODAY for tax submission - Account 40029188
body: Hi there, my accountant (David from TaxAssist) is trying to finalize my self-assessment tax return for my buy-to-let property on Orchard Close, but we are missing the annual mortgage interest statement for the last financial year. I requested this via the portal last week and nothing has arrived. The HMRC filing deadline is midnight and I'm facing an immediate £100 late penalty plus interest if this isn't filed today. Can someone please generate the statement copy and email it directly to this address immediately? Mortgage account number is 40029188.

subject: VERY URGENT fix rate finish / need redemption statement MOR-994821
body: Hello. My fixed rate deal is finish on 30 November. I need you to send me payoff quote redemption paper urgently for my new lender. I ask for this last week on phone but nothing come. My new bank say if I do not give paper by tomorrow they cancel my new deal. If I go to your standard variable rate I cannot pay. I am disabled and live on small benefit, I cannot afford big jump in payment, my family will have no money for food and heat. Please send payoff quote to my email today or I must report to financial ombudsman because this is making me very sick with stress. Account number MOR-994821.

subject: Joint Mortgage Ref M/8849102-A - Notice of Arrears & Change in Circumstances
body: Hello, I'm writing on behalf of myself and my husband, Mark Taylor, regarding our joint mortgage account M/8849102-A. We received a letter yesterday about the missed payment from last month and I need to get this sorted out as soon as possible. Mark was made redundant in November and although I'm still working, my income alone doesn't cover the full monthly payment of £1,240 alongside our other essential bills. We're not trying to dodge this, but receiving automated warning letters isn't helping when we've been trying to call your helpline without getting through. Please can someone contact us to discuss setting up a temporary reduced payment plan or a payment holiday? We really need some guidance before the next payment attempt on the 1st.

subject: Fixed rate ending next week - Mortgage Acct 88401928
body: Hi, my current 2-year fixed deal (ref 88401928) finishes on the 31st of this month and I am getting genuinely panicked about the jump to SVR. My main client went into administration two months ago so my turnover has taken a massive hit. My accountant, Mr. Henderson, is currently finalizing my reduced tax returns to reflect this drop in income, but as it stands, I simply cannot afford the £1,450 SVR payment that will be drawn next week. I've tried calling twice this morning but kept getting cut off after 20 minutes on hold. I need someone to look at switching me to an affordable product or arranging temporary interest-only terms urgently before the direct debit goes through. Please call me today on 07700 900123.

subject: URGENT: BTL Account 4019-3382-11 - Tenant default and upcoming payment
body: Dear Customer Support, I am writing to you for the third time regarding my Buy-to-Let mortgage for 14 Maple Close (Account 4019-3382-11). As explained in my previous emails on Tuesday and Thursday, my long-term tenant suddenly abandoned the property owing three months' rent, leaving extensive damage. I am currently out of pocket by over £4,000 and facing a major shortfall. My monthly payment of £890 is due this Friday. While I always pride myself on keeping up with my financial commitments, I simply do not have the liquidity to cover this payment right now without risking total personal insolvency. I have been extremely patient waiting for a callback from your specialist team, but time has now run out. Please treat this email with the utmost urgency and advise what forbearance options are available today.

subject: Mortgage Account: M-992014-A - Escalation of Arrears and Financial Hardship
body:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to formally log my current financial distress regarding the above mortgage account, following a severe illness that has rendered me unable to work since November.

1. Current Situation: I received your recent letter stating my account is now £1,840.00 in arrears.
2. Cause of Hardship: Due to a sudden diagnosis, my income has dropped to Statutory Sick Pay (£109.40/week), creating a deficit of £950.00 per month against my commitments.
3. Failure of Process: I submitted my completed Income & Expenditure form on 4th January via registered post, but received an automated late payment fee notice yesterday regardless.
4. Required Action: I require an immediate pause on arrears fees and a formal assessment for a reduced payment plan to prevent further legal escalation. Money is being taken that I cannot replace, and I need a senior advisor to contact me by 4pm today.

Yours faithfully,
Arthur Pendelton

subject: Follow up regarding ref: INC-883910 (Date 12/01/2024) - Rate Expiry Next Month
body: Hello, I am following up on my contact from 12th January under reference number INC-883910. I still haven't received a callback regarding my fixed rate ending on 1st March (Mortgage Ref 66209182). Since I was made redundant shortly before Christmas, my partner's income alone will not cover the variable rate of £1,920/mo you are threatening to move us to. We are already struggling to buy groceries this month. The fixed rate deal expires in less than two weeks and I am terrified of what happens when that new payment leaves our bank account. I've already provided all our financial figures during my last call. Please, can someone look at reference INC-883910 immediately and confirm what options we have to keep our payments manageable?

subject: Mortgage Account 40928172 - Notice of Intention to Repossess / Medical vulnerability
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing following three extremely distressful phone calls this week regarding mortgage account 40928172. As explained previously, my husband suffered a major stroke in November which reduced our household income overnight. I submitted the requested income and expenditure forms on 12th February.

Despite this, I received a formal notice yesterday threatening court action and repossession within 14 days. This constant harassment is severely impacting my husband's recovery and my own mental health. We have lived in this home for twelve years and have never missed a payment prior to this medical emergency.

I need someone from the specialist collections team to contact me directly by phone today to freeze the fees and agree a temporary concession. If I do not receive a human response before 4pm, I will be lodging a formal complaint with the Financial Ombudsman Service and contacting my local MP, as your treatment of vulnerable customers is completely unacceptable.

Yours faithfully,
Eleanor Vance

subject: Urgent - Ref 882019/MA - Fix ending 31st March / Inability to pay SVR
body:
Fix ends end of month on 882019/MA. SVR payment is £1,850/mo up from £920. My main client contract ended Jan so business income down 60%. I literally cannot pay £1,850.

Tried switching online, system keeps erroring out. If you put me onto SVR I will immediately default and lose the house. 

Need someone to call me on 07700 900812 today. Between meetings till 2pm then free. If I am forced into default because your portal isn't working I will report this directly to the FCA for unfair treatment. Fix this ASAP.

subject: INVOICE #INV-884021 - Apex Catering Supplies UK
body:
Good morning,

Please find attached our tax invoice INV-884021 for the commercial grease trap maintenance carried out on 12th October at your Manchester site. 

Total due: £450.00 + VAT. Payment terms are 30 days net. 

Regards,
Accounts Payable
Apex Catering Supplies Ltd

body:
Thank you for your email. I am currently out of the office on annual leave until Tuesday 14th November with no access to emails.

For all non-urgent supplier enquiries, I will respond when I am back in the office.

Kind regards,
Sarah Jenkins
Senior Events Coordinator

body:
Thank you for your email. I am currently out of the office on annual leave returning Monday 11th November, with no access to my inbox. 

If your email relates to urgent supplier disbursements, court proceedings, or time-sensitive stop-orders where funds are at immediate risk, please redirect your message urgently to finance-escalations@hartley-logistics.co.uk or contact the duty manager on 0121 496 0982.
